verdict.rationale: The official Okta MCP server lets an AI agent run natural-language management operations. Its examples include queries that span many items at once, such as listing all apps unused in the past month or all failed logins in 24 hours. SCIM gives a REST CRUD API over users and groups. None of this documents true bulk write or batch actions, so support is only implied through agent-driven listing and chaining. Missing for 10: documented bulk or batch endpoints or MCP tools for acting on many users, groups or apps at once; guidance on bulk limits relative to rate limits; independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
